properties.name: Ewaso Ng'iro North → Lagh Dera (indicative course)
properties.note: Rain on Mt Kenya's north slopes (Nanyuki–Isiolo) flows down the Ewaso Ng'iro, through the Lorian swamp and into Lagh Dera across Garissa county toward Somalia. Floods reach Habaswein/Modogashe about 5–8 days after heavy Mt Kenya rain.
properties.source: Indicative trace from HydroSHEDS / county lagha network
